description: Draw a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for a new systematic review from the record counts, as a PNG image plus an SVG and download links. Give the counts you have; screened, sought, assessed and reports-included boxes that follow from others are filled in and marked as derived. Studies included is never derived. The tool checks that the numbers add up (records identified minus removed equals screened, and so on) and returns a warning naming each box that does not, with the value it should have. The diagram always shows the numbers exactly as given. Add `otherMethods` counts to draw the second column (websites, organisations, citation searching).

automationIneligible.description: Records marked ineligible by automation tools.

databaseSources.description: Per-database counts before deduplication, e.g. [{"name":"MEDLINE","n":812}]. If databases is also given, the two are compared.

databases.description: Records identified from databases, all databases together, before duplicates are removed. Leave out when databaseSources is given: it is their sum.

otherMethods.description: Counts for the "identification via other methods" column.

otherRemoved.description: Records removed for other reasons before screening.

recordsExcluded.description: Records excluded at title and abstract screening (not reports excluded at full text).

recordsScreened.description: Records screened on title and abstract. Derived when left out: identified minus removed before screening.

registers.description: Records identified from trial registers (ClinicalTrials.gov, ICTRP…), before duplicates are removed.

reportsAssessed.description: Full-text reports assessed for eligibility. Derived when left out: sought minus not retrieved.

reportsExcluded.description: Total full-text reports excluded. If reasons are also given, their sum is compared with it.

reportsExcludedReasons.description: Full-text reports excluded, one entry per reason, e.g. [{"name":"Wrong population","n":12}].

reportsIncluded.description: Reports of included studies. Derived when left out: assessed minus excluded (both columns when otherMethods is drawn).

reportsNotRetrieved.description: Reports that could not be retrieved.

reportsSought.description: Full-text reports sought for retrieval. Derived when left out: screened minus excluded.

studiesIncluded.description: Studies included in the review. Never derived: one study can have several reports, so give it. It cannot exceed reportsIncluded.

footnotes.description: Print the template footnotes and source attribution.

other_methods_column.description: Force the other-methods column on or off. Default: drawn when otherMethods counts are given.

name: prisma_flow_diagram
title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
